wiki.title: Angela Rigas
wiki.extract: Angela Rigas is an American politician from Michigan. A member of the Republican Party, she was elected to the Michigan House of Representatives in the 2022 election from the 79th district, and took office in 2023. After the 2020 presidential election, Rigas questioned the election result and took part in the rally that preceded the January 6 attack at the U.S. Capitol.
